Deeds of Legend: Units with at least 1 model within 6" of this model score Critical Hits on a 5+ instead of a 6+.

Oath of Moment: Once per battle, you can elect to trigger an Oath of Moment with this model during your Command Phase if it is on the battlefield, or when it uses the Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves Action. When doing so, select 1 enemy unit on the battlefield. Friendly Adeptus Astartes units add 1 to their Hit rolls and 1 to their Wound rolls against that unit until the end of the Battle Round.

sections.prose:
Narthecium: While this model is leading a unit, this model can use this ability. During your Command Phase, roll 1 D6 and return a number of wounds the unit has lost equal to that roll. Alternatively, do not roll a D6 and instead return 1 destroyed model from the unit to the battlefield.

Rites of Healing: This model can use this ability once per battle. If your Warlord is destroyed, do not remove that Warlord model from the battlefield. Instead, leave it in place (perhaps on its side). In your next Command Phase, if this model is within 6" of your Warlord, it can use this ability to restore up to D3+1 wounds to your Warlord. After using this ability, your Warlord can be replaced on the battlefield and can act normally.

sections.prose:
Drop Pod Bay: Instead of using this model's standard Transport [X] capacity, players can choose to embark up to 1 Adeptus Astartes Walker unit inside this model.

Drop Pod Assault: This model must begin the battle in Strategic Reserves. Further, this model and friendly Adeptus Astartes units embarked in this model do not count towards the typical restrictions for the percentage of your army that can begin in Strategic Reserves. However, if your army includes more than 3 of this unit, a minimum of 1 of these units must Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves during the first and second Battle Rounds.

Vectored Descent: When this model arrives on the battlefield via strategic reserves using its Deep Strike ability, it does not follow the deployment limitations for that ability. Instead:

  • During Battle Rounds 1, this model can be deployed anywhere on the battlefield that does not contact a terrain feature and is not within 8" (horizontally or vertically) of any enemy models.
  • During Battle Rounds 2, this model can be deployed anywhere on the battlefield that does not contact a terrain feature and is not within 6" (horizontally or vertically) of any enemy models.
  • During Battle Round 3 onwards, this model can be deployed anywhere on the battlefield that does not contact a terrain feature and is not within 3" (horizontally or vertically) of any enemy models.
